summary_points: This document outlines specifications for a rotary control valve.
It includes general information, notice of alternate billing cycle, and confidentiality notices.
The scope of work involves supplying instruments and related items.
Definitions are provided for key terms such as Supplier, Customer, Fabricator, and Owner.
Attachments to the document are considered part of the specification.
The Supplier is responsible for delivering materials to designated locations.
A single contact person must monitor material purchased under this contract.
Contract allows alternate billing cycles.
Confidential and proprietary information.
Material must meet NEC, IEEE, UL standards.
Vendor data required for project progress.
Quotation must include time for approval drawings and fabrication.
Equipment to be delivered to purchaser's manufacturing site.
Shipment by March 1, 2012.
Spare parts list with prices and delivery times required.
Inspection by Abener Teyma personnel before shipment.
Vendor recommendations invited for price, delivery, or performance improvements.
The valve is a rotary control valve with a triple offset design.
It operates on instrument air supply ranging from 60-80 psig.
The valve has a travel range of 0 - 90 degrees.
Material certificates and leakage tests are required.
Process conditions include flow rates, pressures, temperatures, and viscosities.
